archetypes.name: step0-progress-order
archetypes.rationale: Step 0 progress activation has ordering and fail-soft integration risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the Step 0 progress activation ordering. Check that explicit run id fallback, repo-root reuse, and fail-soft activation are pinned by tests without expanding scope. Watch for hidden regressions in timing or session setup command order. Cite the plan lines and code/test evidence you rely on. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
